Dashboard.title: Design system at a glance
Dashboard.description: This page lays out the theme's semantic colors and the components in common use. A HeroUI theme is just a set of CSS variables — edit the ones in src/app/globals.css and every component follows.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Semantic color roles, light and dark handled

platform.label: Platform
platform.hint: Server and client components share one stylesheet

palette.title: Semantic color roles
palette.note: Each role is a set of variables: a base, a readable foreground, and a low-emphasis soft pair. Retheming means editing variables, not components

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.note: HeroUI's variant system: primary / secondary / tertiary / outline / ghost / danger

chips.title: Chips and messages
chips.note: Chip is the status label (HeroUI's Badge is an overlay indicator, not a label); toast replaces the notifications component

form.title: Form controls
form.note: TextField composes Label / Input / FieldError; the focus ring uses the accent color

controls.title: Selection and progress
controls.note: ToggleButtonGroup / Slider / ProgressBar — all compound components

surfaces.title: Alerts and overlays
surfaces.note: Alert's semantic status colors, plus Tooltip
surfaces.alertBody: Alert colors come from the semantic variables, so retheming doesn't touch this.
surfaces.tooltipBody: Tooltips are driven by react-aria, so keyboard focus opens them too

Notes.title: Notes
Notes.description: The template's one complete example: SQLite table → drizzle service → Server Actions (search and optimistic updates included) → HeroUI UI. Delete the whole domain if you don't need it.
Notes.titlePlaceholder: What do you want to remember?
Notes.titleInvalid: A title is required, up to 200 characters
Notes.bodyInvalid: The body can be at most 5000 characters
Notes.emptyHint: Add your first one with the form above.

Settings.title: Settings

notifications.note: Placeholder switches — wire them to your own preference store

Errors.title: This page didn't load
Errors.description: Something went wrong while rendering it. Trying again usually works; if it keeps happening, send us the error id below.

code.VALIDATION: Some of the details aren't valid. Check them and try again.
code.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
code.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
code.NOT_FOUND: That item no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
code.CONFLICT: That conflicts with existing data. Try a different value.
code.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
code.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again shortly.
